description: EveryInfra multi-source fact-checking skill for Codex and Claude Code. Use EverySearch MCP to compare primary sources, verify freshness and produce cited conclusions.

definition: EveryInfra Research is a standalone agent skill for multi-source fact checking using EverySearch MCP. It scopes a current claim, compares original sources and dates, and produces a cited conclusion with contradictions and evidence gaps made explicit.
